notes:
# Phone remote keeps its connection {iphone}
Four faults, all of them the same shape: the Mac looked healthy while
nothing of it was running, and every code a phone scanned came back
"expired". An update left launchd holding our background helper against
the signature it had before -- so the kernel killed it at every launch,
and nothing in the app could see that. The helper also gave up its socket
quietly, and dropped it whenever anything unrelated in the same pass
failed.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Settings > General > Background helper has a Restart button, and it
  restarts it properly: re-installing a job launchd already holds does
  nothing at all.
- A socket whose thread has stopped is replaced instead of reporting
  itself down for ever, which needed a restart of the whole app to clear.
- Clearing the notes question from your phone now clears it on the Mac's
  screen as well.
- Help > System Check names which connection fault it is, and the log
  carries why rather than only that it failed.
